packageRules.description: Playwright is owned by the Playwright Update workflow, not Renovate: a bump must come with the re-vendored trace viewer engine, and it cannot wait in Renovate's queue

@zip.js/zip.js stays pinned at 2.7.29 for the vendored trace viewer service worker: later versions split the Entry type and 2.8+ dropped the lib/zip-no-worker-inflate.js subpath it imports, both of which would force edits to vendored files (see packages/trace-viewer/README.md)
The Vitest reporter contract test runs on the oldest Vitest the reporter supports (its vitest peer range). Patches only; raise the floor deliberately, together with that peer range
better-auth packages pin better-call to an exact version, so bumping one alone splits @better-auth/core into two pnpm instances and every plugin endpoint drops out of InferAPI
@polar-sh/better-auth peers on a specific @polar-sh/sdk major and imports its internal paths, so bumping either one alone breaks at runtime
